purpose: Pre-deploy safety notes for the d570bef deploy round: two live facts that this round did not cause and must not silently inherit.

event.message: TESTNET_ONLY_WRITE_LOCK: Binance Demo Testnet write disabled for this environment/host

blockedWriteAttemptExplained.guard: BinanceTransport.assertTestnetExchangeWrite() throws when environment!=TESTNET or executionMode!=TESTNET_ENABLED or the REST host is not the allowed testnet host
blockedWriteAttemptExplained.actualReason: executionMode is READ_ONLY, so the orphan-TP cancel was refused. No production endpoint or production credential was involved; testnetWrites and productionWrites stayed 0 and lastWriteAt stayed null.
blockedWriteAttemptExplained.labelingObservation: The counter name says production but the same field is incremented by any refused exchange write, including a READ_ONLY refusal. Out of scope for this deploy round; recorded so nobody later reads blockedProductionWriteAttempts=1 as 'a production write was attempted against live'.

positionAndRiskState.note: One position was closed by the operator by hand between the 21:30 deploy and this round (14 -> 13); cycleIds of the remaining 13 are unchanged and each keeps its protected TP.

backgroundHygieneSinceThisInstanceStarte.reading: Transport-level failures over 9 hours with zero exchange writes and no unresolved active risk; none of them is a new P0/P1, and none may be 'fixed' by loosening timeouts or freshness.
